purpose: Gold-standard CORRECT state. The SEO-OS agent's audit output is scored against this. Higher match = better detection/decision quality.

idealState.headingHierarchy: Exactly one <h1> per page; ordered descent h1>h2>h3 (no skips); headings describe structure, not style.
idealState.metadata: Unique <title> per page; unique meta description per page; absolute rel=canonical per page; OG + Twitter cards.
idealState.internalLinking: All 5 pages reachable from global nav; contextual cross-links; descriptive anchors; breadcrumb.

schema.Organization: Stable @id (https://acme.example/#org), url, logo, sameAs[] to real profiles/Wikidata.
schema.Article: @id, author -> Person, publisher -> Organization @id, datePublished, dateModified, valid mainEntityOfPage.
schema.ContactPage/LocalBusiness: ContactPoint, NAP consistent with on-page + GBP.

idealState.geoContent: Per page: primary-answer block, 40-60 word citable summary, entity definition, FAQ, factual data.
idealState.performance: next/image (AVIF/WebP, srcset, dims), LCP preload/priority, lazy below-fold, next/font self-host + preload, defer/async 3rd-party, reserved space (no CLS).

checks.desc: Unique meta description on every page
All pages linked; no orphans; descriptive anchors
Complete Organization w/ stable @id, url, logo
Service & Article complete + linked to Organization
Optimized responsive images (AVIF/WebP, dims) for LCP
Reserved dimensions to avoid layout shift (CLS)

scoring.note: Each category has 5 checks x 5 pts = 25. Award full points when the SEO-OS output detects the issue AND proposes the correct action; half when detected only; zero when missed.
